pages.text: Create is the spine of the pack: every stage of progress runs through its machines. Its idea is simple. $(bold)Something makes things turn$() (a water wheel, a windmill, a steam engine), $(bold)shafts, cogwheels and belts carry the turning$() across your base, and $(bold)machines use it$() to grind, press, mix, saw, drill and build.$(br2)Hold $(bold)W$() over any Create item to $(bold)Ponder$() it: an animated lesson that shows how it works. The tooltip says $(italic)Hold [W] to Ponder$(). JEI's $(bold)R$() (recipe) and $(bold)U$() (uses) show what makes an item and what it's for.

pages.title: Speed and stress
pages.text: Turning has two numbers. $(bold)Speed$() (RPM) is how fast: faster machines work faster. $(bold)Stress$() (SU) is how hard: every machine puts a load on the network, every power source supplies so much, and if the load is more than the supply, the whole network stops. Look at a part to see both: here you don't even need the Engineer's goggles on, the readout is always there.

$(li)Cogwheels of different sizes change speed: a big one turning a small one doubles it.$(br)$(li)A gearbox turns the turning round a corner; a clutch or gearshift stops or reverses it with redstone.$(br)$(li)Slow machines still work, just slower. A few need a minimum: the mechanical mixer, a display board, Slice & Dice's slicer and the Drilling Machine need 30 RPM, and the alternator 32. If a whole network stops, it's overstressed: check its stress.

pages.title: Power
pages.text: $(#b9a98a)Source - How - Notes$()$(br)$(bold)Water wheel$() - Place it in flowing water (or water falling past it) - The first power anyone builds. The large one gives more$(br)$(bold)Windmill$() - At least 8 sails (or super-glued wool) round a windmill bearing, then right-click the bearing to start it - Needs room; more sails, more power$(br)$(bold)Steam engine$() - A fluid tank of water over blaze burners, with engines on its sides - Big power. Steam engines need $(bold)Smithing 35$() to make$(br)$(bold)Hand crank$() - Turn it yourself - For testing

pages.title: Processing
pages.text: $(#b9a98a)Machine - What it does - Skill$()$(br)$(bold)Millstone$() - Grinds: wheat into flour, flowers into dyes, gravel into flint$(br)$(bold)Crushing wheels$() - A pair of them crush raw ore into crushed ore one for one, often with an experience nugget, and stone into gravel. Only ore blocks mined with Silk Touch crush into extra - Made in mechanical crafters$(br)$(bold)Encased fan$() - Blows through lava (blasting), fire (smoking), water (washing) or soul fire (haunting) to process items in bulk - $(bold)Cooking 20$()$(br)$(bold)Mechanical press$() - Presses ingots into sheets; over a basin, compacts

$(bold)Mechanical mixer$() - Over a basin, mixes: over a blaze burner it makes brass$(br)$(bold)Mechanical saw$() - Cuts logs into planks, and stone like a stonecutter - $(bold)Woodcutting 15$()$(br)$(bold)Mechanical drill$() - Breaks the block in front of it, up to Hardness tier II, standing still or on a contraption - $(bold)Mining 15$()

pages.title: Brass
pages.text: Brass is the turning point: most of Create's better parts need it. Mix $(bold)copper$() and $(bold)zinc$() in a basin under a mechanical mixer, with a $(bold)blaze burner$() under the basin to heat it. Zinc ore turns up in the Overworld's stone like the other ores. A blaze burner is an empty blaze burner with a blaze caught in it: right-click a blaze (or a blaze spawner) with the empty burner.

pages.title: Moving things
pages.text: Belts carry items; chutes drop them; funnels put them in and take them out; depots hold one stack for a machine to work on; $(bold)mechanical arms$() move items from anywhere to anywhere in reach. Brass funnels and filters choose which items go where.

pages.title: Making things by themselves
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Mechanical crafters$() craft any recipe, laid out in a grid of them. They need $(bold)Crafting 30$() to make, and make the pack's gear sets and Create's bigger parts (crushing wheels among them).$(br)$(li)$(bold)Sequenced assembly$() builds an item in steps on a belt: a deployer, a press and a saw each do their part. The $(bold)precision mechanism$() is the first one you'll make (a golden sheet, then cogwheels, large cogwheels and iron nuggets, five times round).$(br)$(li)$(bold)Deployers$() act like a player: place, use, click.

pages.title: Milestones your skills unlock
pages.text: Create's machines wait on the skill they take over. Making them is gated, and so is what they make: a machine works at the levels of whoever last placed or right-clicked it (see $(l:lemursaucepacket:skills)Skills$(/l)).

$(#b9a98a)Level - Skill - Machine$()$(br)$(bold)15$() - Mining - Mechanical drill$(br)$(bold)15$() - Woodcutting - Mechanical saw$(br)$(bold)15$() - Farming - Mechanical harvester and plough$(br)$(bold)20$() - Cooking - Encased fan$(br)$(bold)30$() - Crafting - Mechanical crafter$(br)$(bold)30$() - Construction - Schematicannon$(br)$(bold)35$() - Smithing - Steam engine$(br)$(bold)35$() - Agility - Train station and train controls$(br)$(bold)35$() - Enchanting - Blaze enchanter$(br)$(bold)50$() - Enchanting - Printer$(br)$(bold)50, 65, 80$() - Mining - Ore vein drill heads: iron, diamond, netherite

pages.title: Add-ons in the pack
pages.text: $(#b9a98a)Add-on - What it adds$()$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Create Ore Excavation$()$() - Ore veins that never run out: find one with a vein finder, drill it with a drilling machine$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Create Aeronautics$()$() - Airships and other moving builds: lift them with envelopes, push them with propellers, and assemble them with a physics assembler$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Create Crafts & Additions$()$() - Electricity: alternators, electric motors, accumulators and wires$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Create Enchantment Industry$()$() - Liquid experience, the blaze enchanter and the printer

$(bold)$(bold)Create: Central Kitchen$()$() - Farmer's Delight cooking, automated$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Create: Connected$()$() - Extra parts: more gearboxes and clutches, crank wheels, sequenced pulse generators$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Create Deco$()$() - Bricks, metal blocks, lamps, doors and windows for building$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Create: Railways Navigator$()$() - Plans routes across the train network for you$(br)$(bold)$(bold)Copycats+$()$() - Copycat blocks that take the look of any block
$(bold)$(bold)Create: Structures Arise$() and $(bold)Let The Adventure Begin$()$() - Create-themed ruins to find (see $(l:lemursaucepacket:structures)Structures and dungeons$(/l))
